name: Bernice's Necklace
label: Item
description: At Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest, Bernice keeps her late husband's necklace close.
intro: At Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest, Bernice keeps her late husband's necklace close.

p: Auntie Bernice Stonefield's necklace once belonged to her late husband, a veteran of Stormwind's military campaigns. He carried it into battle as a charm for good fortune. Bernice says tragedy came only during his final campaign, the one expedition when he forgot to bring it. Since his death, the keepsake has remained among her most cherished possessions at Stonefield Farm.
